answer: Written in a security-first mindset, threat model explicit register, it stays short. The design leans on homomorphic encryption for private computation. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the beacon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the grove of a task receipt, and the tundra is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
